parts.text:
I have updated the Alpine Ski Co web application with the following improvements:

1. **Background Color & Palette**:
   - Updated the color scheme to a cohesive Alpine theme featuring crisp snow/slate body background (`#f4f8fb`), fresh white cards (`#ffffff`), and soft glacier-tinted services background (`#eaf1f7`).
   - Replaced the previous terracotta colors with Alpine blue primary accents (`#0284c7`, hover: `#0369a1`), icy blue accents (`#e0f2fe`), and deep mountain midnight navy (`#0c1e33`) for the navbar, footer, and contact sections.
